sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Dm/F]God be with you till we meet again; By His counsels [F]guide, uphold [Dm/F]you,
[Eb]With His sheep securely fold you: God be with you till we meet again.
[Eb/Bb]Till we [Bb]meet, till [Dm/A]we meet, Till we meet at [F/C]Jesus' feet,
[Bb]Till we meet, till we meet God be with you till we meet again.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Bb/F]Till we meet, till we meet,
[Bb]Till we meet at [F]Jesus' feet;
[Dm/F]Till we meet, [Cm/Eb]till we meet,
[Gm/D]God be with you till we meet again.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Dm/F]God be with you till we [F]meet again;
[Eb]'Neath His wings securely hide you;
[Eb/Bb]Daily [Dm/A]manna still provide [F/C]you;
[Bb]God be with you till we meet again.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Dm/F]God be with you till we [F]meet again;
[Eb]When life's perils thick confound you;
[Eb/Bb]Put [Bb]His [Dm/A]arms unfailing [F/C]round you;
[Bb]God be with you till we meet again.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Dm/F]God be with you till we [F]meet again;
[Eb]Keep love's banner floating over you,
[Eb/Bb]Strike death's [Bb]threatening [Dm/A]wave before [F/C]you;
[Bb]God be with you till we meet again.
